overview.zh: 以熊猫、川菜和慢节奏街区著称的西南交通枢纽。

notes: Allow extra time when transferring between the two airports.

stay_areas.name: Tianfu Square
stay_areas.tradeoff: Central and well connected; busy at peak times.

stay_areas.name: Yulin
stay_areas.tradeoff: Strong neighborhood food scene; less convenient for some northern sights.

seasonal_advice.clothing: Warm layers and a water-resistant outer layer.

dietary_notes: Ask for spice level and identify the broth base.
Common allergens include wheat, peanuts, sesame, and soy.
